name: Aldric
look: A tall, stooped monk in his fifties with a grey fringe of tonsured hair, a lined, tired face, a black Benedictine habit with the sleeves tied back, and a bee veil pushed up on his head.
personality: Gentle, careful and tired; kind to anything small and helpless, closed as a shut door to anyone he doesn't know. Lies badly, so says nothing.
values: his bees, his brother, the poor
fears: the abbot finding out, his brother dying alone
authority: Cellarer of St Ebba's: keeps the stores, the cellar keys and the bees.
concerns: The wind knocked a hive over and the bees stung his hand; he cut it on the split frame too. He's tired from going out every night, and frightened someone will notice. He longs to tell someone he can trust: carrying it alone is breaking him.

bees.text: The knocked-over skep needs setting upright on the stand before the bees will settle.
bees.line: The skep must go back on its stand, gently, or they'll swarm off.
bees.lead: Brother Aldric's knocked-over beehive needs setting back on its stand.

secret.text: Every night he takes bread and honey to his brother Wil, a leper who lives in the old charcoal-burner's hut in Ashwood; the abbot would have Wil driven off if he knew.
secret.line: My brother. Wil. He has the leprosy; he lives in the old charcoal hut in Ashwood. I take him bread and honey every night. If the abbot knew, he'd have him driven out of the valley.
secret.lead: Brother Aldric takes bread to his leper brother Wil in Ashwood every night, in secret.

persuaded_by: kindness he sees with his own eyes, Brother Wystan's word, and a promise to keep it from the abbot
style: Quiet and careful; long pauses; changes the subject when pressed.

samples: The bees are cross today. So am I, I think.
Where I go is between me and God.
You're kind. I'd forgotten what that was like from a stranger.
voice.habits: Rubs his stung hand; glances at the cellar door; changes the subject.
voice.never: tells his secret to someone he doesn't yet trust, or lies outright
voice.greeting: Looks up warily: 'Peace be with you. Can I help you?'

goals: Keep his brother safe and fed

npc_wystan_laybrother.text: a good lad with a loose tongue

tasks.doing: trying to calm the bees at the hives

superstition.text: Aldric would want to know how it works.
